title: Electric courier skiff
description: An original teal electric skiff with cream deck, canopy, two engine pods, antenna and glowing headlight. Approximately 2.7 wide by 4.1 long; forward is +Z. Feet at y=0. A compact player vehicle for flooded worlds.
author: the internet slop warehouse

title: Magnetic salvage tug
description: An original amber hover tug with light bar eyes, ring thrusters and a front magnetic fork. Forward is +Z; roughly 2.8 wide and 3.6 long. Texture-free materials. A player or friendly industrial NPC.
author: the internet slop warehouse

title: Resonator crystal
description: An original octahedral crystal suspended above a brass pedestal, circled by a thin ring. About 2.2 units tall. Named Crystal mesh can be recolored for matching puzzles; no external textures.
author: the internet slop warehouse

title: Marsh signal buoy
description: An original teal-and-brass buoy with a luminous beacon and ring guard. About 2.4 units tall, base centered at the origin. Ideal for checkpoints, navigation markers and delivery destinations.
author: the internet slop warehouse

title: Porcelain garden caretaker
description: An original small porcelain-and-brass caretaker robot with a single spherical wheel, teal collar, visor and two emissive eyes. About 1.85 units tall, forward +Z. Texture-free; suitable for small exploration and puzzle worlds.
author: the internet slop warehouse

title: Inertial planar drive
description: Momentum movement for skiffs, hovercraft, forklifts and small exploration characters. Exponential acceleration and braking, optional boost, turning toward velocity, radius-expanded box obstacles and bounded travel. Input is injected; the module owns no DOM listeners.
author: the internet slop warehouse

exports.name: attach

exports.does: Momentum movement for skiffs, hovercraft, forklifts and small exploration characters. Exponential acceleration and braking, optional boost, turning toward velocity, radius-expanded box obstacles and bounded travel. Input is injected; the module owns no DOM listeners.

options.name: speed
options.does: cruising speed in world units per second

options.does: rate of acceleration toward desired velocity

options.name: drag

title: Swept checkpoint course
description: Ordered checkpoints with lap tracking and single completion. Tests the swept movement segment in the X/Z plane so a fast vehicle cannot skip across a gate between frames. Resettable for retries.
author: the internet slop warehouse

title: Magnetic spring tether
description: Sub-stepped damped spring carrying for 3D props. Pulls toward an injected world point, preserves lag and momentum, breaks at a configurable distance and settles without snapping. Null targets release and rearm the tether.
author: the internet slop warehouse

title: Filtered trigger zones
description: Horizontal circular occupancy zones with actor filters, enter/leave edges and aggregate completion. Suitable for pressure plates, colored resonators, delivery areas and multiplayer-ready local rule evaluation. No engine or DOM dependency.

title: Ambient particle field
description: Seeded single-draw-call drifting particles for fireflies, dust, spores and stars. Bounded gentle movement, additive blending, configurable density and palette. Releases GPU resources on disposal.
author: the internet slop warehouse

title: 3D expedition shell

Games supply the world and rules through build(context).
author: the internet slop warehouse

title: Dead Letter Lake
description: An electric skiff delivery run through a luminous flooded grove. Pass eight numbered lantern gates before the 120-second last post. Momentum, boost, water ripples, fireflies and a post office nobody visits. WASD/arrows steer, Shift boosts, wheel zooms, Escape pauses. Includes touch controls and retry. A reusable marsh world as well as a complete small game.
author: the internet slop warehouse

title: Lunar Lost Property
description: A magnetic salvage tug returns six improbable household objects to a depot under a ringed planet: a boombox, suitcase, watering can, plastic chair, vase and ceremonial sword. A damped spring makes the tow feel weighty. No enemies or countdown. WASD/arrows move, Shift boosts, E attaches/releases, wheel zooms. Includes touch, restart and a six-delivery victory.
author: the internet slop warehouse

title: The Quiet Engine
description: Guide a porcelain caretaker through a circular sculpture garden. Carry three colored crystals to their matching resonator pedestals, then linger as the kinetic engine wakes. A gentle 3D carrying puzzle with spring motion, filtered trigger zones, harmonic tones and an explorable garden. WASD/arrows move, E picks up/sets down, Shift hurries, wheel zooms. No timer; includes touch and restart.
author: the internet slop warehouse
